staticFrame.alt: A dark archival table seen from above. Source slips lie in open case files, each corded to its origin, and the ledger line where a verdict would be written is left blank.

scenes.label: 01 / The record
scenes.heading: A table, and a rule.
scenes.narration: Everything that reaches Tathya is laid on one table and kept. The record organises what was said. It does not rule on whether it was true.

scenes.label: 02 / Intake
scenes.heading: Everything keeps its name.
scenes.narration: Each source is set down tagged with its kind, official, media, or citizen, and a cord back to where it came from. It is never promoted to the truth.

scenes.label: 03 / Identity
scenes.heading: We have seen this subject before.
scenes.narration: When a source matches a subject already on the table, it joins that file instead of starting a new pile. The stale copy is discarded rather than left to gather beside the current one.

scenes.label: 04 / Citation
scenes.heading: No claim without its cord.
scenes.narration: A claim keeps the cord back to its source. A slip with no source stays on the table, uncited and visible, rather than quietly dropped.

scenes.label: 05 / The file
scenes.heading: Kept together. Not fused.
scenes.narration: Slips about one subject are bound under a loose cord that never cinches. The file carries its own count and the split across official, media, and citizen.

scenes.label: 06 / Conflict
scenes.heading: Two accounts. Same light.
scenes.narration: Conflicting sources are squared side by side at equal weight. The record does not rank them, average them, or let the verdict come down.

scenes.label: 07 / The boundary
scenes.heading: What broke, and what it will not do.
scenes.narration: A source whose collection failed is withdrawn in plain sight and marked as workflow state. The line held the whole way: no verdict, no ranking, no sentiment score.

scenes.label: 08 / Deep dive
scenes.heading: The conclusion is yours.
scenes.narration: The table runs on past where you stopped reading. The case study carries the ingestion, the identity model, the citation graph, and the failures still ahead.

audio.explanation: This world is a silent archival demonstration. It has no audio asset and makes no audio request.
